author: nickyeow

english.text: The most important thing in the Olympic Games is not to win but to take part, just as the most important thing in life is not the triumph but the struggle. The essential thing is not to have conquered but to have fought well.

text: 奧運會最重要嘅唔係贏，而係參與；就好似人生最重要嘅唔係勝利，而係過程中嘅掙扎。最重要嘅唔係克服困難，而係有好好咁奮鬥過。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: Whatsoever therefore is consequent to a time of Warre, where every man is Enemy to every man; the same is consequent to the time, wherein men live without other security, than what their own strength, and their own invention shall furnish them withall. In such condition, there is no place for Industry; because the fruit thereof is uncertain; and consequently no Culture of the Earth; no Navigation, nor use of the commodities that may be imported by Sea; no commodious Building; no Instruments of moving, and removing such things as require much force; no Knowledge of the face of the Earth; no account of Time; no Arts; no Letters; no Society; and which is worst of all, continuall feare, and danger of violent death; And the life of man, solitary, poore, nasty, brutish, and short.

text: 所以，無論係咩，係戰爭時代嘅結果，每個人都係每個人嘅敵人；因為佢嘅果實係唔確定嘅；因此，冇地球嘅文化；亦冇航海，亦冇使用可能透過海上進口嘅商品；冇寬敞嘅建築物；冇移動嘅工具，同埋拆走呢啲需要大量力量嘅嘢；對地球嘅面冇認識；冇時間嘅記錄；冇藝術；冇信；冇社會；最慘嘅係，不斷恐懼，同埋暴力死亡嘅危險；而人嘅生命，孤獨、窮、討厭、殘酷同短暫。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: There are four types of changes in French present verb conjugations: the change in length, with singular forms usually being shorter than the plural forms, the change in letters, with the "je," "tu," "il/elle," and "ils/elles" forms being slightly different from the "nous" and "vous" forms, spelling changes, where the conjugation changes due to the nature of French verbs, and any other irregular change that doesn't fit in the first three categories.

jyutping: faat3 man2 jin6 zoi6 dung6 ci4 ge3 bin3 faa3 jau5 sei3 zung2：coeng4 dou6 ge3 bin3 faa3，daan1 sou3 jing4 sik1 tung1 soeng4 dyun2 gwo3 fuk1 sou3 jing4 sik1；zi6 mou5 ge3 bin3 faa3，「 je 」、「 tu 」、「 il / elle 」tung4「 ils / elles 」jing4 sik1 tung4「 nous 」tung4「 vous 」jing4 sik1 loek6 jau5 m4 tung4，ping3 se2 bin3 faa3，kei4 zung1 ge3 bin3 faa3，jan1 wai6 faat3 man2 ge3 saam1 go3 leoi6 bit6 m4 sik1 hap6，ji4 jam6 ho4 kei4 taa1 m4 kwai1 zak1 dung6 ci4 ge3 sing3 zat1 dou1 hai6 m4 sik1 hap6 ge3。
text: 法文現在動詞嘅變化有四種：長度嘅變化，單數形式通常短過複數形式；字母嘅變化，「 je 」、「 tu 」、「 il / elle 」同「 ils / elles 」形式同「 nous 」同「 vous 」形式略有唔同，拼寫變化，其中嘅變化，因為法文嘅三個類別唔適合，而任何其他唔規則動詞嘅性質都係唔適合嘅。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: In the wild countrey of the South, wherein the sunne beateth mightily upon the sandes, there liveth a people both ancient and wise, that feed upon divers creatures, such as the stranger would marvell at. For whereas our tables are garnished with bread, with fleshe, and with wine, their sustenance is found in the very bowels of the earth and in the flights of the aire. Chiefest among these meats is the Witchetty Grubbe, the fat larva of a moth, which hideth it selfe in the roote of the Acacia. With a staffe the women digge the grounde, and plucke forth this white worme of notable bignes. Some eat it raw, even then when it is taken from the roote, saying it hath the taste of almond or of the yolke of an egge. Others do cast it into the fire, so that the skinne is made crisp and the inside savoury, like unto the flesh of a bird well roasted. Thus doth the desert yeeld a dish both wholesome and strong. No lesse esteemed is the Honie Ant, whose belly is swolne with sweet licour, for shee serveth as a living vessel of nectar. The children plucke them gently from the earth, and at the biting of their bellies they finde a drinke more pleasant than the cuppe of grape. A small thing it is, yet of great delight.

jyutping: hai2 naam4 fong1 ge3 fong1 je5 gwok3 gaa1，joeng4 gwong1 maang5 lit6 dei6 paak3 daa2 saa1 dei6，jau5 jat1 go3 gei3 gu2 lou5 jau6 zi3 wai3 ge3 man4 zuk6，keoi5 dei6 ji5 do1 zung2 sang1 mat6 wai6 sik6，hou2 ci5 mak6 sang1 jan4 wui5 ging1 taan3 gam2。 jan1 wai6 ngo5 dei6 ge3 toi2 hai6 jung6 min6 baau1、juk6 tung4 zau2 zong1 sik1 ge3，daan6 hai6 keoi5 dei6 ge3 sik6 mat6 zau6 hai6 hai2 dei6 kau4 ge3 zeoi3 sam1 cyu5 tung4 hung1 zung1 ge3 fei1 hang4 jap6 min6 wan2 dou2。 ni1 di1 juk6 dong1 zung1 zeoi3 zyu2 jiu3 ge3 hai6 Witchetty Grubbe，keoi5 hai6 jat1 zung2 fei1 ngo4 ge3 zi1 fong1 jau3 cung4，keoi5 wui5 zoeng1 zi6 gei2 cong4 hai2 soeng1 si1 ge3 gan1 bou6。 di1 neoi5 jan2 jung6 gwan3 zi2 waat3 dei6，jin4 hau6 bat6 ceot1 ni1 zek3 baak6 sik1 ge3 daai6 cung4。 jau5 di1 jan4 wui5 saang1 sik6，zau6 syun3 hai6 gam2，dong1 keoi5 hai2 gan1 bou6 lo2 lai4 ge3 si4 hau6，dou1 waa6 keoi5 jau5 hang6 jan4 waak6 ze2 daan2 wong2 ge3 mei6 dou6。 kei4 taa1 jan4 wui5 zoeng1 keoi5 fong3 jap6 fo2 dou6，ling6 dou3 pei4 bin3 dak1 ceoi3，jap6 min6 bei2 gaau3 haam4 di1，hou2 ci5 siu1 dak1 hou2 ge3 zoek3 juk6 gam2。 gam2 joeng2，saa1 mok6 zau6 caan2 sang1 zo2 jat1 dou6 gei3 gin6 hong1 jau6 koeng4 zong3 ge3 coi3 sik1。 tung4 joeng6 sau6 jan4 zyun1 ging3 ge3 hai6 Honie Ant，keoi5 ge3 tou5 naam5 bei6 tim4 gam1 lou6 zung2 hei2，jan1 wai6 keoi5 hai6 jat1 go3 wut6 saang1 saang1 ge3 faa1 mat6 jung4 hei3。 di1 siu2 pang4 jau5 heng6 heng1 gam2 zoeng1 keoi5 dei6 cung4 dei6 soeng6 zaak6 zau2，dong1 keoi5 dei6 ngaau5 zyu6 keoi5 dei6 go3 tou5 go2 zan6，keoi5 dei6 faat3 jin6 jat1 bui1 gang3 jyu6 faai3 gwo3 pou4 tou4 bui1 ge3 jam2 ban2。 ni1 go3 hai6 jat1 gin6 siu2 si6，daan6 hai6 ling6 jan4 hou2 hoi1 sam1。
text: 喺南方嘅荒野國家，陽光猛烈地拍打沙地，有一個既古老又智慧嘅民族，佢哋以多種生物為食，好似陌生人會驚嘆噉。 因為我哋嘅枱係用麵包、肉同酒裝飾嘅，但係佢哋嘅食物就係喺地球嘅最深處同空中嘅飛行入面搵到。 呢啲肉當中最主要嘅係Witchetty Grubbe，佢係一種飛蛾嘅脂肪幼蟲，佢會將自己藏喺相思嘅根部。 啲女人用棍子挖地，然後拔出呢隻白色嘅大蟲。 有啲人會生食，就算係咁，當佢喺根部攞嚟嘅時候，都話佢有杏仁或者蛋黃嘅味道。 其他人會將佢放入火度，令到皮變得脆，入面比較鹹啲，好似燒得好嘅雀肉噉。 噉樣，沙漠就產生咗一道既健康又強壯嘅菜式。 同樣受人尊敬嘅係Honie Ant，佢嘅肚腩被甜甘露腫起，因為佢係一個活生生嘅花蜜容器。 啲小朋友輕輕噉將佢哋從地上摘走，當佢哋咬住佢哋個肚嗰陣，佢哋發現一杯更愉快過葡萄杯嘅飲品。 呢個係一件小事，但係令人好開心。
